LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Meta.Meta__Description: The Custom Scrapbook: items Adam saves from a selection on a sheet and drags back onto any sheet of any project. Owned by Na__LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__.js (the library), Na__LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Transport__.js (the files) and Na__LayoutEditor__Panel__ScrapbookCustom__.js (the section). An item is one JSON file in a category folder of the user content folder at the app root; a dropped item becomes ordinary sheet records - vectors, text, leaders and dimensions, grouped as they were - so it moves, copies, prints and undoes like anything drawn by hand.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Meta.Meta__Files: Library__ContentFolder is the local repository, beside Index.html. Each category is a folder Adam made in it; an item is UserScrapbookItem__<Name>__<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>.json inside one. Library__IndexFile lists every item and is rewritten by the local server on every save and delete, from what is actually in the folders, so a file added or taken away by hand is picked up. The live website has no directory listing: the index is what makes the library readable there once the repository is pushed.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Meta.Meta__Saving: Saving and deleting go through the ProjectVision local server (na-apps/ProjectVision__TrueVisionScrapbook__Api__.py, routes under Library__ApiPath). Without it - a plain static server, or the live website - the library is read-only and the section says so. A delete moves the file into 00__Deleted__Quarantine; nothing is unlinked.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Meta.Meta__Portable: An item is made portable as it is saved: layer ids, a dimension's viewport, a bubble's specification note link and a parametric element's viewport link are all facts about the sheet or the project it came from, and are left behind. Viewports are refused: a viewport carries a scene, a snapshot and a model source.

LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Library.Library__Description: Where the items live and what they may hold. See Meta__Files and Meta__Saving.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Library.Library__CategoriesNote: The folders, in the order the section lists them. Category__Folder must be a folder that exists: the server saves into the folders that are there and never makes one.

LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__Description: The Custom Scrapbook section's wording. {name} is an item's name, {count} a number of items, {category} a category's name, {reason} why something failed.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__Hint: Your saved items. Drag one onto the sheet, or double-click it. Right-click one to delete it.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__Failed: The custom scrapbook could not be read.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__ReadOnlyView: Items can only be placed while sheets are editable.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__ItemTitle: {name}: drag onto the sheet, or double-click to place it in the middle of the view. Right-click to delete it.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__SaveNothing: Select something on the sheet - vectors, text, leaders, dimensions or groups - to save it here.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__SaveReady: {count} selected. Name it and save it to {category}.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__SaveViewports: Viewports cannot be saved: they belong to this project. Leave them out of the selection.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__SaveNoServer: Saving needs the ProjectVision local server. This library is read-only here.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__SaveRestart: The ProjectVision local server is running without the scrapbook routes. Restart it, then save.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__ToastDeleted: Moved {name} to the scrapbook's quarantine folder.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookCustom__Labels.Labels__ConfirmDelete: Delete {name} from the Custom Scrapbook? The file is moved to the scrapbook's quarantine folder, not erased.
